title: Express endpoint: GET /api/posture/frameworks — per-framework compliance percentages
prompt:
Task: Express endpoint: GET /api/posture/frameworks — per-framework compliance percentages

Implementation:
- Add GET /api/posture/frameworks to server/index.ts
- Query memory daemon via Unix socket /run/user/1000/embry/memory.sock:
- POST /list {collection: 'sparta_controls', return_fields: ['control_id','source_framework','nrs_score','weaknesses'], limit: 0}
- POST /list {collection: 'sparta_qra', return_fields: ['control_id'], group_by: 'control_id', limit: 0}
- Server-side aggregation:
- Group controls by source_framework (NIST, SPARTA, CWE, ATT&CK, ISO, etc.)
- For each framework: { name, total, withQRAs, pct: Math.round(withQRAs/total*100) }
- Derive overallScore as weighted average of framework pcts
- Return JSON: { overallScore, delta: 0, frameworks: [...] }
- On memory daemon connection failure: res.status(502).json({error: 'Memory daemon unavailable'})

Definition of Done:
- Command: curl -sf http://localhost:3001/api/posture/frameworks | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert isinstance(d['overallScore'], (int,float)); assert len(d['frameworks']) >= 3"
- Assertion: exit_code == 0

Tests:
- curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/posture/frameworks | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert 'overallScore' in d; assert len(d['frameworks']) > 0; print(f'PASS: {len(d["frameworks"])} frameworks, score={d["overallScore"]}')"
